messages:
mila: Pulled together Orpheus postmortem follow-ups. Root cause: transient peering flap + concurrent KV rekey during shard rebalance -> tenant traffic fell through to default route. I made a concise action list with owners. Doc: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/orpheus-2026
sync-bot: Follow-up created: ORP-2101 (orpheus-remediate) 
 tracker: https://tracker.redwood.com/ORP-2101
arun: I'll take the peering controller changes: idempotent reconcile + pre-apply route sanity. Plan: PR + staging by Wed. CHG-7801. Need customer's maintenance window confirmation.
tay: I'll own the KV rekey/race fix. Repro on onprem-harness at ~8-10k connections; failing in kv::rekey_and_apply when rebalance overlaps. Estimate 48h for patch + tests. PR will be posted: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/1602
gabi: I'll coordinate customer comms and the interim mitigation (edge fanout cap). Ticket CUST-14820. Will request firewall/peering windows and propose validation call.
mila: Owners summary: peering -> @arun (CHG-7801 / ORP-2101), kv -> @tay (ORP-2101 / PR pending), comms -> @gabi (CUST-14820). Please add exact dates & blockers by EOD.
arun: Customer accepts Tue/Thu 23:00-03:00 JST. Proposing Thu 00:30 JST. I'll include rollback steps in CHG.
tay: Running extended repro now; if green target staging deploy Tue. Adding integration tests for shard alignment during rebuilds.
gabi: Draft notice ready; holding until CHG scheduled. Will send 8h prior and schedule post-change validation call.
mila: Adding alerts: "tenant_route_fallthrough" > 3/min and "kv_rekey_errors" spikes. Linking those to ORP-2101 and scheduling a biweekly trends review.
arun: I'll add a pre-apply assertion to refuse route apply if peer ranges overlap unexpectedly.
tay: Also adding a guard that delays shard rebalance until rekey completes to avoid interleaving.
sync-bot: Linked issues: ORP-2101, CHG-7801, CUST-14820 
 https://tracker.redwood.com/ORP-2101
mila: Thanks — if that timeline holds I'll close immediate follow-ups and start the biweekly trend sync. Ping me for urgent slips. :thumbsup:
